title: Machine-based and person-based UAP summoning systems

tellings.quote: There are two types of summoning that can be done that we've proven works and we're still working with.

plain: There are two ways to call in unidentified flying craft, one that uses a machine and one that relies on a person, and both have been shown to work, according to Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he flew a recovered UFO. Barber speaks as someone involved in the work, saying these are "two types of summoning that can be done that we've proven works and we're still working with." If true, it would mean people can deliberately make such craft appear.
